name: multiview-demo
// targets: MediaPackage V2 Dynamic MultiView demo stack. Parent template.yaml + one nested stack per source (source.yaml). Deploys with sam deploy like the api and webui apps (capabilities and resolve_s3 live in samconfig.toml; SAM packages the nested source.yaml). Linted with cfn-lint on both files (W3002 expected, ignored).

deploy.command: sam deploy --stack-name="trackflix-multiview-$STAGE" --parameter-overrides Stage="$STAGE" --tags Project=trackflix-live Owner="$STAGE" Name="trackflix-multiview-$STAGE" --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
